name: Vibe Manufacturing
description: Hosted endpoint for getting parts manufactured. An agent can match a part spec (process, material, certification, quantity, CAD format, country) to contract manufacturers from a directory compiled from open data and company websites, list suppliers by country and city, estimate landed cost and the price for a target margin, read a 13-step idea-to-product playbook, and send a quote request on behalf of its user after consent. No sign-up or key needed.
author: Vibe Manufacturing
